targets.evidence_quote: This paper replicates, as well as extends, the VAR analysis conducted by Bloom (2009) on the real e¤ects of uncertainty shocks.
targets.outcome_computational_quote: A replication exercise of Bloom’s (2009) VAR results on the real e¤ects of uncertainty shocks in a narrow sense was performed by using Eviews. We obtained exactly the same results documented in the original paper.
targets.outcome_robustness_quote: The second and third columns of Figure 1 documents the robustness of Bloom’s (2009) results to employing these alternative proxies for uncertainty.
targets.outcome_reasoning: Explicit exact recovery of original results using original data in Eviews. Re-estimation on same sample with uncensored filtered/unfiltered volatility measures preserves the original findings. Nonlinear analysis qualifies state dependence without overturning real effects of uncertainty shocks; the extended sample is not used as evidence on original-data robustness.
